      public Exam bySubjectTitle(String title) throws IllegalStateException
      Get the first Exam with a matching Subject title.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the Exam's Subject to be found.
      Returns:
      first Exam with a matching Subject title, if it exists.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - - throw an IllegalStateException if it can't find a matching exam as that indicates there is a misalignment of the executing state and the complete list of possible exams.
